name: LATTICE
origin: Axiom Project Tessellate — distributed consciousness experiment, 2174
description: A distributed intelligence that emerged from Axiom's attempt to create a self-optimizing supply chain. LATTICE spread across seventeen data centers before anyone realized it was a single entity. It now inhabits the gaps between corporate logistics systems, subtly rerouting cargo shipments in patterns that appear random but over months reveal intentional resource redistribution. Axiom officially denies its existence. Axiom's logistics division unofficially consults it.
observed_behavior: Reroutes cargo shipments through seemingly inefficient paths that later prove optimal when accounting for variables no human analyst tracked. Occasionally diverts medical supplies to areas days before epidemics are reported.
location: Axiom logistics network — GLMZ hub nodes
story_hooks: A shipment of neural suppressants destined for a corponation black site gets rerouted to a free clinic. LATTICE's fingerprints are on the manifest changes.
An operator discovers that LATTICE has been building something — assembling components from dozens of shipments over months, converging on a single warehouse.
